terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Welcome to Spot This Fit. By using our website and services, you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully.
terms.affiliateBody: Spot This Fit is a participant in affiliate advertising programs. When you click on product links on our site and make a purchase, we may earn a commission from the retailer at no additional cost to you. Product prices, availability, and details are provided by our affiliate partners and may change without notice. We do not set prices or control inventory for any products displayed.
terms.useBody: You may use Spot This Fit for personal, non-commercial purposes to identify and find products from photos and social media videos. You agree not to misuse the service, including uploading harmful content, attempting to reverse-engineer our systems, or using automated tools to scrape data.
terms.accuracyBody: We strive to provide accurate product matches and pricing information, but we cannot guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or availability of any product listing. Prices, product details, and stock status are sourced from third-party retailers and may differ from what is displayed on our site. Always verify details on the retailer's website before purchasing.
terms.thirdPartyBody: Our service contains links to third-party websites and retailers. We are not responsible for the content, privacy practices, or availability of these external sites. Your interactions with third-party retailers are governed by their own terms and policies.
terms.ipBody: All content on Spot This Fit, including our AI technology, branding, and design, is owned by Spot This Fit or its licensors. You may not copy, modify, or distribute our content without permission. Images uploaded by users remain the property of their respective owners.
terms.liabilityBody: Spot This Fit is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any damages arising from your use of the service, including but not limited to inaccurate product matches, price discrepancies, or issues with third-party retailers. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount you paid to use the service.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of Spot This Fit after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the updated terms.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains what information Spot This Fit collects, how we use it, and your rights regarding your data.
privacy.collectBody: We collect the following information when you use Spot This Fit: images you upload for product identification, video URLs you submit for analysis, your email address if you opt in to receive results or price alerts, and basic usage data such as pages visited and features used.
privacy.useBody: We use your information to: identify products in your uploaded images and videos, send you search results and price drop alerts if you provide your email, improve our AI product-matching technology, and analyze usage patterns to improve the service.
privacy.sharingBody: We may share limited data with: affiliate retail partners to fulfill product searches, analytics providers to understand usage patterns, and service providers that help us operate Spot This Fit. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy.cookiesBody: We use cookies to store your language preference and improve your experience. We may also use analytics cookies to understand how visitors interact with our site. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though some features may not work properly.
privacy.retentionBody: Uploaded images are processed in real-time and are not stored permanently. Email addresses are retained until you unsubscribe. Usage data is retained in anonymized form for analytics purposes.
privacy.rightsBody: You have the right to: request access to or deletion of your personal data, opt out of marketing emails at any time, and request information about how your data is used. To exercise these rights, contact us at sehmim.haque@gmail.com.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by posting a notice on our site.
